definitions.gloss: exhibit; display item; item on display
definitions.explanation: An object put on display for viewing, as in a museum, gallery, store, or exhibition. In retail, it often refers to a floor model or demonstration unit.

examples.japanese: {展示品|てんじひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not touch the exhibits.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{展示品|てんじひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものです。
examples.english: This exhibit is from the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}→家電量販店：23345_kadenryouhanten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{展示品|てんじひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a display model cheaply at an electronics store.

notes:
{展示品|てんじひん} refers to any item put on display, whether in a museum, gallery, trade show, or retail store.

FORMS:
⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧ (exhibition/display) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item/goods)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {展示品|てんじひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{触|ふ}れないで→触れる：01984_fureru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please do not touch the exhibits (museum/gallery sign)
- {展示品|てんじひん}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: display model only (retail discount)
- {展示品|てんじひん}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: clearance of display items

USAGE:
In museums and galleries, {展示品|てんじひん} means exhibits or displayed artifacts. In retail (especially electronics stores), it refers to floor models or demonstration units, which are often sold at a discount.
